title: Weedle Eats Its Own Weight in Leaves Every Day
premise: At 3.2 kg, Weedle eats its own body weight in leaves every day.
audiencePromise: Watch Weedle's daily leaf pile match its body weight, then discover how specifically it chooses those leaves.
openLoop: How does a 3.2 kg Weedle choose an equal-weight leaf meal?
payoff: The equal-weight meal is selective: Weedle sniffs out favorite leaves, while its head carries a venomous stinger.
engagementQuestion: Would you trust Weedle's warning colors or fear its barb?

voice.instructions: {"tone":"quick, amazed, and playful","pacing":"crisp lines with a short pause before the final question","emphasis":"stress three point two kilos, whole Weedle, big red proboscis, and venomous stinger"}

scenes.headline: WEEDLE EATS ITSELF?
scenes.narration: Weedle eats its weight in leaves. Every day.
scenes.caption: ONE WEEDLE'S WEIGHT, IN LEAVES

scenes.headline: JUST 3.2 KILOS
scenes.narration: It weighs only three point two kilos, yet eats that much.
scenes.caption: WEEDLE'S ENTIRE BODY: 3.2 KG

scenes.headline: ONE WHOLE WEEDLE OF LEAVES
scenes.narration: That means its leaf pile equals a whole Weedle.
scenes.caption: BODY WEIGHT = DAILY LEAVES

scenes.headline: THE BIG RED NOSE PICKS
scenes.narration: Its big red proboscis sniffs out favorite leaves.
scenes.caption: IT CAN TELL FAVORITES FROM DISLIKED LEAVES

scenes.headline: BUT ITS HEAD IS ARMED
scenes.narration: That leaf-picker's head also carries a sharp venomous stinger.
scenes.caption: A FOOD-FINDER AND A POISON DEFENSE

scenes.headline: COLOR WARNING OR BARB?
scenes.narration: Would you trust Weedle's warning colors or fear its barb?
scenes.caption: SELECTIVE LEAF-EATER. VENOMOUS DEFENDER.
